goal.objective: Consume authentic current-device Device->KV and TVC custody/readback evidence, invoke only canonical Interlock/InTr continuation, and emit one fail-closed Device->KV->SKAP->KV->Device terminal proof.
success_predicates: four adjacent canonical InTr hops exist in DEVICE_SYSTEM->KV->SKAP_VAULT->KV->DEVICE_SYSTEM order
all current packet bytes match their intent payload hashes
each hop receipt is canonical, boundary-verified, RECEIVED, and hash-valid
each next intent is chained to the previous terminal receipt hash
SKAP and KV exact readback are observed and receipt-bound
no secret plaintext or authority transfer appears in transport evidence
canonical Node identity/continuity binding is preserved
no hosted runtime or second user-operated device is used
failure_predicates: source or CI evidence is treated as runtime proof
missing or fabricated hop receipt is accepted
the worker self-authorizes or fabricates a transition receipt instead of invoking canonical Interlock/InTr
detached request/response pairs are accepted as one roundtrip
mutated packet bytes retain eligibility through a stale intent hash
readback is absent or detached from the admitted lineage
GitHub, Heartbeat, transport, or the verifier grants execution or credential authority
authority_ceiling: invoke canonical Interlock/InTr continuation only after prerequisite evidence is already admitted
canonical InTr connector may materialize receipt evidence for the invoked transition
no duplicate SKAP ciphertext custody write

task.derivation_reason: The parent revalidates KV connection/provider state; this child separately owns the end-to-end Device<->KV<->SKAP transport/runtime proof so the parent is not widened into a different operational capability.

terminal_when: all four authentic hop receipts validate
SKAP and KV exact readback validate
completion.next_authorized_action: Return the non-authorizing proof to canonical task reconciliation; do not infer provider or credential authority.
